name: Erik Gustavsson
bio:
Erik's motorsport journey began in his youth, tinkering with engines in his father's garage in Gothenburg. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering from Chalmers University of Technology, specializing in automotive design. After graduating, he worked for Volvo's racing division before making the leap to IndyCar. Erik's meticulous approach to car setup and his ability to quickly diagnose and resolve mechanical issues made him a valuable asset to various teams. 

He joined Team Penske five years ago, initially as a senior engineer before being promoted to Chief Engineer. Erik excels at analyzing data and translating it into actionable insights for the drivers and mechanics. While he's not always the most charismatic, his unwavering commitment to performance and his deep technical knowledge are highly respected within the team. He is known for his relentless pursuit of marginal gains, believing that every small improvement contributes to overall success.

Erik's distinctive trait is his ability to maintain a calm demeanor even under immense pressure. He is a true professional, dedicated to his craft and committed to pushing the boundaries of motorsport engineering.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: Erik is a man of medium height with a lean build, reflecting his focused and disciplined lifestyle.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of cleaning his glasses obsessively, even when they appear spotless.
Speaks in a low, measured tone, rarely raising his voice, even when stressed.
